Executive Order 320

Executive Order 320-A (1905)

by President of the United States
Amending Executive Order of August 13, 1902, to Authorize Navy Department to Discharge Men of Messmen Branch who Enlist for Summer Practice Cruises

Executive Order 321

→

sister projects: Wikidata item

more info.

Amends Executive Order of August 13, 1902. Also see Executive Order 558, February 4, 1907.

Signed by President Theodore Roosevelt Wednesday, April 26, 1905

615691Executive Order 320-A — Amending Executive Order of August 13, 1902, to Authorize Navy Department to Discharge Men of Messmen Branch who Enlist for Summer Practice Cruises1905President of the United States

The Executive Order of August 13, 1902, is so far modified that the Navy Department is authorized to discharge, upon request, men of the messmen branch who enlist for service with the midshipmen of the Naval Academy on their summer practice cruise.

Theodore Roosevelt.

White House,

April 26, 1905.

This work is in the public domain in the United States because it is a work of the United States federal government (see 17 U.S.C. 105).
